data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 per the statement of financial position was GBP 304.206m. The 2017 results were impacted by major natural catastrophe activity (notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the California wildfires) and movements on prior underwriting years; however the report does not provide a single, explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure in a clearly labelled 'movement in prior year provision' line that could be unambiguously extracted. The claims development tables (gross) are present in the notes and list cumulative incurred development by underwriting year; named catastrophe events are identified in the notes as drivers of 2017 claims activity.
raw_causal_phrases: Major catastrophe events during 2017, including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, California Wildfires, were experienced in 2017
The syndicate generated an underwriting loss of GBP 37.5m for the year
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding (GBP 304.206m) was read from the Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities) prior-year comparative column (page 14) and is high confidence. The report contains a gross claims development (triangle) table (page 40) that was readable, but the explicit GROSS movement in the 'prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (the preferred authoritative single-line gross PYD) was not clearly labelled or numerically isolated in a single movement note that could be reliably extracted. Because of this, no single gross prior-year development figure was returned. Named catastrophes (Harvey/Irma/Maria, California wildfires) are explicitly mentioned in the notes (page 28) and were captured. The claims development triangle is present (gross) but extraction of a robust summed prior-year development from that triangle requires precise cell-level reads which could not be unambiguously achieved from the provided images; hence PYD is left null rather than risk an incorrect gross figure. Where figures were read from tables they are in the document's native units (GBP '000).
